tasks.title: Initialize Repository Structure
tasks.description: Create the project directory structure and initialize the git repository according to the PRD specifications.
tasks.details:
1. Create the main project directory `claudecode-session-orchestrator`
2. Initialize git repository with `git init`
3. Create all subdirectories as specified in the PRD:
   - src/ (with orchestrator, monitoring, analytics, intervention, learning subdirectories)
   - tests/ (with unit, integration, performance, fixtures subdirectories)
   - scripts/ (with emergency-fixes and deployment subdirectories)
   - docs/
   - .github/workflows/
   - .taskmaster/ (with tasks, docs, config subdirectories)
4. Create initial empty files to maintain directory structure
5. Create a comprehensive .gitignore file with Python patterns (include __pycache__, .pytest_cache, .coverage, etc.)

Implementation should use Python 3.11+ compatible patterns and follow the exact structure specified in the PRD.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify the directory structure matches the PRD specification by running a script that checks for the existence of all required directories and files. Ensure git repository is properly initialized by checking for .git directory and running `git status`.

subtasks.title: Create Main Project Directory
subtasks.description: Establish the root directory named 'claudecode-session-orchestrator' as the base for all project files and subdirectories.
subtasks.details: Create the main project directory at the desired location, ensuring it is named exactly as specified in the PRD.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify the existence and correct naming of the root directory.

subtasks.title: Initialize Git Repository
subtasks.description: Initialize a new git repository within the main project directory to enable version control.
subtasks.details: Run 'git init' inside the 'claudecode-session-orchestrator' directory to create a .git folder and prepare for version tracking.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check for the presence of the .git directory and confirm 'git status' runs without error.

subtasks.title: Create Project Subdirectories
subtasks.description: Establish all required subdirectories as specified in the PRD, including nested structures for source code, tests, scripts, documentation, workflows, and task management.
subtasks.details: Create the following subdirectories: src/orchestrator, src/monitoring, src/analytics, src/intervention, src/learning, tests/unit, tests/integration, tests/performance, tests/fixtures, scripts/emergency-fixes, scripts/deployment, docs, .github/workflows, .taskmaster/tasks, .taskmaster/docs, .taskmaster/config.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run a script to verify the existence and correct nesting of all required directories.

subtasks.title: Add Initial Placeholder Files
subtasks.description: Insert initial empty files (such as .gitkeep or README.md) into each directory to ensure the structure is preserved in version control.
subtasks.details: Place a .gitkeep or README.md file in each newly created directory and subdirectory to maintain their presence in the git repository.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check that each directory contains at least one file and that all files are tracked by git.

subtasks.title: Create Python-Specific .gitignore File
subtasks.description: Generate a comprehensive .gitignore file in the project root, including patterns for Python 3.11+ environments and common build, cache, and test artifacts.
subtasks.details: Include entries such as __pycache__/, .pytest_cache/, .coverage, *.pyc, *.pyo, .env, .venv, and any other patterns relevant to Python projects as per modern standards.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that the .gitignore file exists, contains all required patterns, and that ignored files are not tracked by git.

tasks.title: Configure Pixi Environment
tasks.description: Set up the pixi-only dependency management system with the configuration specified in the PRD.
tasks.details:
1. Install pixi if not already available (https://pixi.sh)
2. Initialize pixi in the project root with `pixi init`
3. Create the pyproject.toml file with the exact configuration from the PRD
4. Configure the following features as specified:
   - dev: ruff, mypy, black, isort, pre-commit
   - testing: pytest, pytest-cov, pytest-asyncio, coverage
   - monitoring: psutil, pexpect
   - analytics: pandas, numpy
   - learning: scikit-learn
5. Set up the environments (default, production, development)
6. Configure the pixi tasks for testing, linting, formatting, etc.
7. Run `pixi install` to create the initial environment

Ensure Python 3.11+ compatibility and strict adherence to the pixi-only dependency policy.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify pixi configuration by running `pixi info` and checking that all dependencies are correctly installed. Test each pixi task to ensure they execute correctly. Verify that no non-pixi dependencies are introduced by checking for absence of requirements.txt, setup.py, etc.

subtasks.title: Install Pixi and Verify Installation
subtasks.description: Ensure Pixi is installed on the system and verify its availability by running the Pixi CLI.
subtasks.details: Check if Pixi is installed by running `pixi --version`. If not present, install Pixi following the official installation instructions from pixi.sh.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `pixi --version` and confirm the CLI outputs the installed version without errors.

subtasks.title: Initialize Pixi Project with pyproject.toml
subtasks.description: Initialize a new Pixi project in the repository root using pyproject.toml as the configuration file.
subtasks.details: Run `pixi init --format pyproject` in the project root to create a pyproject.toml file configured for Pixi.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify that pyproject.toml is created in the project root and contains Pixi-specific configuration sections.

subtasks.title: Configure Dependencies and Features in pyproject.toml
subtasks.description: Add all required dependencies and configure feature groups (dev, testing, monitoring, analytics, learning) as specified in the PRD.
subtasks.details: Use `pixi add` and `pixi add --pypi` commands to add dependencies for each feature group. Ensure Python 3.11+ is specified and only Pixi-managed dependencies are present.
subtasks.testStrategy: Check pyproject.toml for correct dependency entries and absence of non-Pixi dependency files (e.g., requirements.txt, setup.py).

subtasks.title: Set Up Environments and Pixi Tasks
subtasks.description: Define multiple environments (default, production, development) and configure Pixi tasks for testing, linting, formatting, etc.
subtasks.details: Edit pyproject.toml to declare environments and use `pixi task add` to create tasks for each workflow (e.g., test, lint, format).
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `pixi info` to verify environments and list tasks. Execute each task to confirm correct operation.

subtasks.title: Install Dependencies and Validate Environment
subtasks.description: Install all dependencies using Pixi and validate that the environment is correctly set up and functional.
subtasks.details: Run `pixi install` to create the environment. Use `pixi info` and manual checks to ensure all dependencies are installed and tasks execute as expected.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run `pixi info` and each configured task. Confirm all dependencies are present and no non-Pixi dependency management files exist.

tasks.title: Set Up CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Configure GitHub Actions workflows for continuous integration, release management, and security scanning.
tasks.details:
1. Create the .github/workflows/ directory
2. Implement ci.yml workflow as specified in the PRD with the following jobs:
   - Quality gates job that runs on push and pull requests
   - Steps for checkout, pixi setup, dependency installation, quality checks, and performance benchmarks
3. Create release.yml for automated release management with:
   - Semantic versioning enforcement
   - Automated changelog generation
   - Package building and publishing
4. Create security.yml for security scanning with:
   - Dependency vulnerability scanning
   - Code security analysis
   - SAST (Static Application Security Testing)

Use GitHub Actions v4 for checkout and the latest prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.4.1 action. Configure workflows to enforce the zero-tolerance quality policy with 100% test coverage requirement.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate workflow files using GitHub Actions lint tools. Test workflows locally using act (https://github.com/nektos/act) if possible. Verify that all quality gates are properly enforced by introducing test failures and confirming the pipeline fails appropriately.

subtasks.title: Create .github/workflows Directory
subtasks.description: Establish the .github/workflows directory in the repository to store all workflow YAML files required for CI/CD processes.
subtasks.details: Ensure the directory exists at the root of the repository to enable GitHub Actions workflows to be recognized and executed.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify the presence of the .github/workflows directory in the repository and confirm that GitHub Actions recognizes workflow files placed within it.

subtasks.title: Implement ci.yml Workflow for Continuous Integration
subtasks.description: Develop the ci.yml workflow to automate quality gates, dependency installation, and performance benchmarks on push and pull request events.
subtasks.details: Configure jobs for code checkout (using actions/checkout@v4), pixi setup (using prefix-dev/setup-pixi@v0.4.1), dependency installation, quality checks, and performance benchmarks. Enforce a zero-tolerance quality policy with 100% test coverage requirement.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate the workflow by introducing code changes that fail quality gates or reduce test coverage, ensuring the pipeline fails as expected. Use GitHub Actions lint tools and test locally with act.

subtasks.title: Create release.yml Workflow for Automated Release Management
subtasks.description: Develop the release.yml workflow to automate semantic versioning, changelog generation, and package publishing.
subtasks.details: Configure jobs to enforce semantic versioning, generate changelogs automatically, build packages, and publish releases upon successful completion of CI checks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Trigger release events and verify that versioning, changelog generation, and package publishing occur as specified. Confirm that releases are blocked if CI checks fail.

subtasks.title: Create security.yml Workflow for Security Scanning
subtasks.description: Develop the security.yml workflow to automate dependency vulnerability scanning, code security analysis, and SAST.
subtasks.details: Configure jobs to run dependency vulnerability scans, perform static code analysis, and execute SAST tools on relevant events (e.g., push, pull request).
subtasks.testStrategy: Introduce known vulnerabilities or insecure code patterns and verify that the workflow detects and reports them. Confirm that the pipeline fails or flags issues as required.

subtasks.title: Validate and Enforce Workflow Quality Gates
subtasks.description: Ensure all workflows enforce the zero-tolerance quality policy and 100% test coverage, and validate their correct operation.
subtasks.details: Test all workflows by simulating failure scenarios (e.g., failing tests, security issues) and confirm that the pipeline blocks merges or releases as intended. Use GitHub Actions lint tools and act for local validation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Systematically introduce failures in CI, release, and security workflows to verify enforcement of quality gates and test coverage requirements. Document results and adjust workflow configurations as needed.

subtasks.title: Draft README.md

subtasks.details: Structure the README with clear sections and concise language. Use Markdown formatting for readability. Include code blocks for commands and usage examples. Add hyperlinks to other documentation files. Ensure the README serves as the entry point for new users and contributors.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate Markdown syntax using a linter. Check all links to ensure they are not broken. Render the README on GitHub to verify formatting and accessibility.

subtasks.title: Develop Architecture Overview
subtasks.description: Create architecture.md detailing the system's component overview, interaction diagrams, data flow descriptions, and technical design decisions.
subtasks.details: Use clear headers and bullet points for each section. Incorporate diagrams using Mermaid syntax to illustrate component interactions and data flows. Document key architectural decisions and their rationale. Ensure technical accuracy and clarity for both developers and stakeholders.

subtasks.title: Write User Guide
subtasks.description: Create user-guide.md with step-by-step usage instructions, configuration options, common use cases, and a troubleshooting guide.
subtasks.details: Organize the guide with clear sections and sequential instructions. Use code blocks for commands and configuration examples. Include practical scenarios and solutions to common issues. Ensure the guide is accessible to both novice and advanced users.

subtasks.title: Generate API Reference

subtasks.details: Use consistent formatting for each API element. Include code snippets and usage examples where relevant. Clearly document input parameters, expected outputs, and error conditions. Ensure the reference is comprehensive and up-to-date with the codebase.

subtasks.title: Document Development Guidelines
subtasks.description: Create development.md with setup instructions, contribution guidelines, code style standards, and testing requirements.
subtasks.details: Provide step-by-step environment setup instructions. Define contribution workflow, including branching, pull requests, and code review. Specify code style conventions and testing protocols. Use Markdown formatting and include code blocks for commands and configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Follow setup and contribution steps to verify accuracy. Check for consistency with project practices. Validate Markdown syntax and ensure all referenced files and links are correct.

tasks.title: Implement Session Manager
tasks.description: Develop the core tmux session orchestration functionality for managing ClaudeCode sessions.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/orchestrator/session_manager.py with SessionManager class
2. Implement functionality to:
   - Create new tmux sessions with proper naming
   - Attach to existing sessions
   - List active sessions
   - Terminate sessions safely
   - Monitor session status
3. Use pexpect (via pixi dependency) for tmux interaction
4. Implement proper error handling and logging
5. Create configuration options for session parameters
6. Ensure non-intrusive operation with < 5% performance overhead

Implementation should use async/await patterns where appropriate for non-blocking operation. Use Python 3.11+ features like match/case for control flow. Ensure proper type annotations throughout the code.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests with pytest that mock tmux interactions using pytest-mock. Implement integration tests that create actual tmux sessions and verify correct behavior. Measure performance overhead to ensure it's below 5%. Test edge cases like session creation failures, already existing sessions, etc.

subtasks.title: Design SessionManager Class and Configuration
subtasks.description: Define the SessionManager class structure in src/orchestrator/session_manager.py, including configuration options for session parameters and type annotations.
subtasks.details: Establish the class interface, configuration schema, and ensure compatibility with async/await patterns and Python 3.11+ features such as match/case. Prepare for extensibility and maintainability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify class instantiation and configuration parsing with unit tests. Check type annotations using static analysis tools.

subtasks.title: Implement Core Tmux Session Operations
subtasks.description: Develop methods to create, attach, list, terminate, and monitor tmux sessions using pexpect (via pixi) for process interaction.
subtasks.details: Ensure proper session naming, safe termination, and accurate status monitoring. Use async/await for non-blocking operations where appropriate. Integrate with tmux via pexpect for robust automation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests that mock tmux interactions using pytest-mock. Implement integration tests that create and manage real tmux sessions, verifying all operations.

subtasks.title: Integrate Error Handling and Logging
subtasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling and structured logging to all session management operations.
subtasks.details: Capture and log errors from tmux and pexpect interactions. Use structured logging for traceability. Ensure that exceptions are handled gracefully and do not disrupt other operations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test error scenarios such as session creation failures and invalid operations. Verify that errors are logged and handled without crashing the system.

subtasks.title: Optimize for Non-Intrusive Performance
subtasks.description: Profile and optimize the SessionManager to ensure less than 5% performance overhead during operation.
subtasks.details: Measure performance impact using benchmarks. Refactor code to minimize blocking calls and resource usage. Document performance characteristics.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run performance tests under load and measure overhead. Ensure compliance with the <5% overhead requirement.

subtasks.title: Finalize Async Patterns and Type Annotations
subtasks.description: Review and refactor all code to ensure consistent use of async/await patterns and complete, correct type annotations.
subtasks.details: Audit the codebase for synchronous bottlenecks and missing type hints. Refactor as needed to maximize concurrency and maintainability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use static analysis tools to verify type annotations. Run concurrency tests to ensure async operations function correctly and efficiently.

tasks.title: Develop Coordinator Component
tasks.description: Implement the coordinator module to manage interactions between different system components.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/orchestrator/coordinator.py with Coordinator class
2. Implement component registration and discovery system
3. Create event dispatching mechanism for inter-component communication
4. Implement configuration management for components
5. Add lifecycle management (initialization, startup, shutdown)
6. Create error handling and recovery mechanisms
7. Implement health monitoring for all components

Use the observer pattern for event notifications. Implement proper dependency injection for component registration. Use asyncio for event handling to ensure non-blocking operation. Ensure thread safety for concurrent operations.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for component registration, event dispatching, and lifecycle management. Test error handling by simulating component failures. Create integration tests that verify proper interaction between multiple components. Test concurrent operations to ensure thread safety.

subtasks.title: Implement Component Registration and Discovery System
subtasks.description: Design and implement a mechanism for components to register themselves with the Coordinator and for other components to discover registered peers. Ensure support for both registration and querying roles, and maintain an up-to-date registry of active components.
subtasks.details: Use dependency injection to allow flexible component registration. Maintain a thread-safe registry of components. Support both registration (for discoverable components) and querying (for components that need to find others). Ensure registry updates are atomic and consistent.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for registration, deregistration, and discovery operations. Simulate concurrent registrations and queries to verify thread safety and correctness.

subtasks.title: Develop Event Dispatching and Observer Notification Mechanism
subtasks.description: Create an event dispatching system that enables inter-component communication using the observer pattern. Ensure that components can subscribe to and receive notifications for relevant events.
subtasks.details: Implement an asyncio-based event loop for non-blocking event handling. Use the observer pattern to allow components to register as listeners for specific event types. Ensure thread safety and proper synchronization for event dispatch and notification.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for event subscription, dispatch, and notification. Test with multiple concurrent event publishers and subscribers to verify non-blocking operation and correct delivery.

subtasks.title: Implement Configuration and Lifecycle Management
subtasks.description: Provide mechanisms for managing component configuration and lifecycle, including initialization, startup, and shutdown procedures.
subtasks.details: Allow components to register configuration parameters with the Coordinator. Implement lifecycle hooks for initialization, startup, and shutdown. Ensure that lifecycle transitions are coordinated and thread-safe.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for configuration updates and lifecycle transitions. Simulate component failures during lifecycle events to verify robustness.

subtasks.title: Add Error Handling, Recovery, and Health Monitoring
subtasks.description: Integrate error handling and recovery mechanisms, and implement health monitoring for all registered components.
subtasks.details: Monitor component health using periodic checks. Implement error detection, logging, and recovery strategies. Notify dependent components of failures using the event system. Ensure that health monitoring and recovery actions are non-blocking and thread-safe.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate component errors and failures to test error handling and recovery. Verify that health monitoring detects failures and triggers appropriate notifications and recovery actions.

subtasks.title: Integrate and Validate Coordinator Functionality
subtasks.description: Combine all implemented features into the Coordinator class and validate end-to-end functionality, ensuring thread safety, non-blocking operation, and correct inter-component coordination.
subtasks.details: Integrate registration, discovery, event dispatching, configuration, lifecycle, error handling, and health monitoring into a cohesive Coordinator implementation. Ensure all operations are asyncio-compatible and thread-safe.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create integration tests covering registration, discovery, event dispatching, lifecycle management, error handling, and health monitoring. Test concurrent operations and simulate real-world usage scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Configuration Management
tasks.description: Create a robust configuration system for managing application settings across all components.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/orchestrator/config.py with ConfigManager class
2. Implement configuration loading from multiple sources:
   - Default configurations
   - Configuration files (YAML/TOML)
   - Environment variables
   - Command line arguments
3. Add validation for configuration values
4. Implement dynamic configuration updates
5. Create hierarchical configuration with inheritance
6. Add secure storage for sensitive configuration
7. Implement configuration change notifications

Use Python's dataclasses with proper type annotations for configuration objects. Implement validation using Pydantic-like patterns (without adding the dependency). Use environment variable prefixing (CLAUDECODE_*) for organization.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for configuration loading from different sources, validation, and hierarchical inheritance. Test configuration change notifications. Create integration tests that verify configuration is correctly applied to components. Test security of sensitive configuration storage.

subtasks.title: Design ConfigManager and Configuration Schema
subtasks.description: Define the ConfigManager class in src/orchestrator/config.py and create Python dataclasses with type annotations to represent configuration objects. Establish a schema that supports hierarchical and layered configuration, including inheritance.
subtasks.details: Use Python dataclasses for configuration objects, ensuring type safety and clarity. Structure the schema to allow for default values, overrides, and inheritance. Prepare for integration with multiple configuration sources.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests to verify correct instantiation of configuration objects, type enforcement, and inheritance behavior.

subtasks.title: Implement Multi-Source Configuration Loading
subtasks.description: Develop mechanisms in ConfigManager to load configuration from default values, YAML/TOML files, environment variables (with CLAUDECODE_* prefix), and command line arguments, supporting layered overrides.
subtasks.details: Parse and merge configurations from all sources in a defined precedence order. Ensure environment variable prefixing for organization. Support dynamic reloading where possible.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for each source type and integration tests for layered loading and precedence handling.

subtasks.title: Add Configuration Validation and Error Handling
subtasks.description: Implement validation logic for configuration values using Pydantic-like patterns (without external dependencies), including type checks, required fields, and custom constraints.
subtasks.details: Integrate validation into the loading process. Raise clear, actionable errors for invalid or missing configuration values. Allow for custom validators on sensitive or complex fields.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for valid and invalid configurations, covering all validation rules and error scenarios.

subtasks.title: Enable Secure Storage and Sensitive Value Handling
subtasks.description: Integrate secure storage mechanisms for sensitive configuration values (e.g., secrets, API keys), supporting encryption or integration with external secret managers.
subtasks.details: Identify sensitive fields in the schema and ensure they are securely loaded and stored. Prevent accidental exposure in logs or error messages. Support decryption or retrieval from secure sources.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test secure loading, storage, and retrieval of sensitive values. Verify that sensitive data is not exposed in logs or exceptions.

subtasks.title: Implement Dynamic Updates and Change Notifications
subtasks.description: Support runtime updates to configuration and notify subscribed components of changes, ensuring consistency and minimal disruption.
subtasks.details: Provide APIs for dynamic configuration updates. Implement observer or callback mechanisms for change notifications. Ensure thread safety and atomic updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit and integration tests for dynamic updates, notification delivery, and correct propagation of changes to dependent components.

tasks.title: Implement Agent Monitor
tasks.description: Develop the non-intrusive monitoring system for tracking ClaudeCode sub-agent behavior.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/monitoring/agent_monitor.py with AgentMonitor class
2. Implement session output parsing and analysis
3. Create sub-agent activity detection and tracking
4. Implement behavior pattern recognition
5. Add performance impact monitoring
6. Create configurable monitoring levels
7. Implement real-time monitoring dashboard

Use regular expressions and parsing techniques to analyze session output. Implement pattern matching algorithms to detect sub-agent activities. Use sampling techniques to minimize performance impact. Ensure monitoring is completely non-intrusive and doesn't affect agent behavior.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for output parsing and pattern recognition. Create integration tests with simulated session output. Measure performance impact to ensure it's below 5%. Test with various monitoring levels to verify configurability. Test edge cases like malformed output and unexpected patterns.

subtasks.title: Design AgentMonitor Class and Core Architecture
subtasks.description: Define the AgentMonitor class in src/monitoring/agent_monitor.py, establishing the architecture for non-intrusive monitoring, including interfaces for session output parsing, activity tracking, and performance impact minimization.
subtasks.details: Establish the class structure, core methods, and extensibility points for monitoring ClaudeCode sub-agent behavior. Ensure the design supports agentless, non-intrusive operation and is compatible with future enhancements.
subtasks.testStrategy: Review class interfaces and architecture for completeness. Conduct code reviews to ensure extensibility and adherence to non-intrusive principles.

subtasks.title: Implement Session Output Parsing and Analysis
subtasks.description: Develop robust parsing logic using regular expressions and parsing techniques to extract relevant events and data from sub-agent session outputs.
subtasks.details: Create methods to process raw session output streams, identify structured and unstructured patterns, and handle edge cases such as malformed or unexpected output. Ensure parsing is efficient and does not impact agent performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for parsing logic with a variety of session output samples, including malformed and edge-case data.

subtasks.title: Develop Sub-Agent Activity Detection and Tracking
subtasks.description: Implement pattern matching algorithms to detect and track sub-agent activities based on parsed session output.
subtasks.details: Define activity signatures and use regular expressions or state machines to identify sub-agent actions. Maintain an activity log and support real-time tracking without interfering with agent execution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit and integration tests to verify accurate detection and tracking of sub-agent activities across diverse scenarios.

subtasks.title: Integrate Behavior Pattern Recognition and Configurable Monitoring Levels
subtasks.description: Add behavior pattern recognition using pattern matching algorithms and implement configurable monitoring levels to adjust monitoring granularity and performance impact.
subtasks.details: Enable detection of behavioral patterns (e.g., anomalies, repeated actions) and allow runtime configuration of monitoring depth (sampling rates, event types). Ensure configuration changes are applied non-intrusively.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test pattern recognition accuracy and verify that monitoring levels can be adjusted dynamically without affecting agent behavior.

subtasks.title: Implement Performance Impact Monitoring and Real-Time Dashboard
subtasks.description: Monitor the performance impact of the monitoring system using sampling techniques and provide a real-time dashboard for visualizing sub-agent activities and monitoring metrics.
subtasks.details: Measure and log resource usage attributable to monitoring, ensuring overhead remains below defined thresholds. Develop a dashboard to display activity, patterns, and performance metrics in real time.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create integration tests to measure monitoring overhead, verify dashboard accuracy, and ensure system remains non-intrusive under various workloads.

tasks.title: Implement Performance Tracker
tasks.description: Create the performance metrics collection system for monitoring ClaudeCode session performance.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/monitoring/performance_tracker.py with PerformanceTracker class
2. Implement metrics collection for:
   - Response time
   - Memory usage
   - CPU utilization
   - Session duration
   - Sub-agent invocation frequency
   - Error rates
3. Create time-series data storage
4. Implement statistical analysis functions
5. Add anomaly detection
6. Create performance baseline establishment
7. Implement threshold-based alerting

Use psutil for system resource monitoring. Implement efficient time-series data storage with downsampling for historical data. Use statistical methods for anomaly detection (z-score, moving averages, etc.). Ensure minimal performance impact.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for metric collection and statistical analysis. Create integration tests that verify metrics are correctly collected from actual sessions. Test anomaly detection with simulated anomalies. Measure the performance impact of the tracker itself to ensure it's minimal.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement PerformanceTracker Class
subtasks.description: Create the PerformanceTracker class in src/monitoring/performance_tracker.py to serve as the core interface for collecting and managing performance metrics.
subtasks.details: Define the class structure, initialize required attributes, and set up interfaces for metric collection, storage, and analysis. Ensure extensibility for future metrics and monitoring features.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests to verify class initialization, attribute setup, and method signatures.

subtasks.title: Implement Metrics Collection Using psutil
subtasks.description: Develop methods within PerformanceTracker to collect key metrics: response time, memory usage, CPU utilization, session duration, sub-agent invocation frequency, and error rates.
subtasks.details: Use psutil for system resource monitoring. Employ decorators or context managers to measure response time and session duration. Track sub-agent invocations and error rates via counters.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for each metric collection method. Use integration tests to verify metrics are accurately collected during simulated sessions.

subtasks.title: Implement Efficient Time-Series Data Storage with Downsampling
subtasks.description: Develop a storage mechanism within PerformanceTracker to store collected metrics as time-series data, supporting efficient querying and historical downsampling.
subtasks.details: Choose or implement a lightweight in-memory or file-based time-series storage solution. Add downsampling logic to aggregate older data points for long-term storage efficiency.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test data insertion, retrieval, and downsampling accuracy. Simulate high-frequency metric collection to ensure storage performance and correctness.

subtasks.title: Implement Statistical Analysis and Anomaly Detection
subtasks.description: Add statistical analysis functions (e.g., moving averages, z-score) and anomaly detection logic to identify abnormal metric patterns.
subtasks.details: Implement statistical calculations for each metric. Use z-score and moving average methods for anomaly detection. Ensure analysis is efficient and minimally impacts performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for statistical functions and anomaly detection. Simulate metric anomalies to verify detection accuracy.

subtasks.title: Establish Performance Baselines and Implement Threshold-Based Alerting
subtasks.description: Develop logic to establish baseline performance metrics and trigger alerts when thresholds are exceeded or anomalies are detected.
subtasks.details: Analyze historical data to compute baselines. Allow configuration of static or dynamic thresholds. Integrate alerting mechanisms (e.g., logging, callbacks) for threshold violations or detected anomalies.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test baseline computation and threshold configuration. Simulate threshold breaches and anomalies to verify alerting functionality.

tasks.title: Implement Compliance Monitor
tasks.description: Develop the system for validating framework compliance in ClaudeCode sessions.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/monitoring/compliance_monitor.py with ComplianceMonitor class
2. Implement rule-based compliance checking
3. Create compliance policy definition system
4. Implement real-time compliance validation
5. Add compliance reporting and visualization
6. Create compliance trend analysis
7. Implement automated compliance remediation suggestions

Use a rule engine pattern for flexible compliance rule definition. Implement policy versioning to track changes over time. Use pattern matching for identifying compliance violations. Create a scoring system for overall compliance measurement.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for rule evaluation and policy validation. Create integration tests with simulated compliance violations. Test with various policy configurations. Verify that compliance reporting accurately reflects the actual state. Test edge cases like conflicting rules and policy changes.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Compliance Rule Engine
subtasks.description: Develop a flexible rule engine to define, manage, and execute compliance rules for ClaudeCode sessions, supporting pattern matching and automated violation detection.
subtasks.details: Use a rule engine pattern (e.g., Drools or custom implementation) to allow dynamic rule definition, storage, and execution. Ensure support for pattern matching to identify compliance violations in real time. Enable easy addition, modification, and removal of rules.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for rule parsing, execution, and violation detection. Test with various rule sets and simulated session data to ensure correct identification of compliance breaches.

subtasks.title: Develop Compliance Policy Definition and Versioning System
subtasks.description: Create a system for defining, storing, and versioning compliance policies, enabling tracking of policy changes over time.
subtasks.details: Implement a structured format (e.g., JSON or YAML) for policy definitions. Integrate policy versioning to record changes, support rollbacks, and maintain an audit trail of policy evolution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test policy creation, update, and rollback operations. Verify that version history is accurately maintained and that the correct policy version is applied during compliance checks.

subtasks.title: Implement Real-Time Compliance Validation and Scoring
subtasks.description: Enable real-time validation of ClaudeCode sessions against active compliance policies, with a scoring system to quantify overall compliance.
subtasks.details: Integrate the rule engine with session event streams to perform continuous compliance checks. Develop a scoring mechanism that aggregates rule outcomes into an overall compliance score for each session.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate live session data and verify that violations are detected in real time. Test the scoring system for accuracy and consistency across different compliance scenarios.

subtasks.title: Build Compliance Reporting, Visualization, and Trend Analysis
subtasks.description: Create reporting and visualization tools to present compliance status, violations, and trends over time.
subtasks.details: Develop dashboards and reports that display compliance scores, violation details, and historical trends. Implement visualizations for policy adherence and compliance evolution.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test report generation with various datasets. Verify that visualizations accurately reflect compliance data and that trend analysis identifies significant changes or recurring issues.

subtasks.title: Implement Automated Compliance Remediation Suggestions
subtasks.description: Develop a system to generate automated remediation suggestions for detected compliance violations.
subtasks.details: Analyze violation patterns and policy requirements to provide actionable remediation steps. Integrate suggestions into reports and dashboards for user review.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test suggestion generation with different violation scenarios. Validate that recommendations are relevant, actionable, and improve compliance outcomes when followed.

tasks.title: Implement Metrics Processor
tasks.description: Create the real-time metrics processing system for analyzing performance data.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/analytics/metrics_processor.py with MetricsProcessor class
2. Implement real-time metric calculation
3. Create derived metrics computation
4. Implement statistical analysis functions
5. Add data aggregation and summarization
6. Create metric correlation analysis
7. Implement metric visualization preparation

Use efficient numerical processing with numpy for calculations. Implement sliding window algorithms for real-time analysis. Use statistical methods for correlation analysis. Create proper data structures for efficient storage and retrieval.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for metric calculations and statistical analysis. Create integration tests that verify correct processing of actual metrics data. Test with large datasets to ensure performance. Verify accuracy of derived metrics and correlations.

subtasks.title: Design MetricsProcessor Class and Data Structures
subtasks.description: Define the MetricsProcessor class in src/analytics/metrics_processor.py and implement efficient data structures for real-time metric storage and retrieval using numpy arrays and appropriate in-memory buffers.
subtasks.details: Establish the class interface, select data structures for storing incoming metrics, and ensure compatibility with sliding window algorithms for real-time analysis.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests to verify correct initialization, data ingestion, and storage efficiency for various metric types and volumes.

subtasks.title: Implement Real-Time Metric Calculation with Sliding Window Algorithms
subtasks.description: Develop methods for real-time calculation of basic metrics (e.g., mean, min, max, count) using sliding window algorithms for low-latency analysis.
subtasks.details: Utilize numpy for efficient numerical computation and implement sliding window logic to support continuous, up-to-date metric calculations as new data arrives.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for metric calculation accuracy and performance under high-frequency data streams. Include edge cases for window boundaries and empty windows.

subtasks.title: Create Derived Metrics and Statistical Analysis Functions
subtasks.description: Implement computation of derived metrics (e.g., rates, ratios, moving averages) and statistical analysis functions (e.g., variance, standard deviation, percentiles) within the MetricsProcessor.
subtasks.details: Ensure derived metrics are computed efficiently from base metrics and that statistical functions leverage numpy for speed and accuracy.
subtasks.testStrategy: Develop unit tests for correctness of derived metrics and statistical outputs, including tests with synthetic and real-world data.

subtasks.title: Add Data Aggregation, Summarization, and Correlation Analysis
subtasks.description: Implement aggregation and summarization methods (e.g., grouping by time intervals, summarizing across metric types) and statistical correlation analysis between metrics using appropriate statistical methods.
subtasks.details: Support flexible aggregation windows and efficient computation of correlations (e.g., Pearson, Spearman) between selected metrics.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit and integration tests for aggregation accuracy, summarization correctness, and correlation analysis validity using controlled datasets.

subtasks.title: Prepare Data for Metric Visualization
subtasks.description: Develop methods to transform and format processed metrics data for visualization, supporting real-time dashboards and external visualization tools.
subtasks.details: Ensure output formats are compatible with visualization libraries and dashboards, and support efficient data retrieval for time-series plots and summary charts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests to verify correct data formatting and compatibility with visualization tools. Test with large datasets to ensure responsiveness.

tasks.title: Implement Trend Analyzer
tasks.description: Develop the system for analyzing performance trends and patterns over time.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/analytics/trend_analyzer.py with TrendAnalyzer class
2. Implement time-series trend detection
3. Create pattern recognition algorithms
4. Implement seasonality and periodicity detection
5. Add regression analysis for trend prediction
6. Create anomaly and outlier detection
7. Implement trend visualization and reporting

Use time-series analysis techniques like moving averages, exponential smoothing, and ARIMA models. Implement pattern recognition using machine learning techniques from scikit-learn. Use statistical methods for anomaly detection.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for trend detection and pattern recognition algorithms. Create integration tests with historical data to verify trend analysis. Test prediction accuracy with known outcomes. Test with various patterns and anomalies to ensure robust detection.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement TrendAnalyzer Class Structure
subtasks.description: Create the foundational TrendAnalyzer class in src/analytics/trend_analyzer.py, defining interfaces for trend detection, pattern recognition, seasonality analysis, regression, anomaly detection, and visualization.
subtasks.details: Establish the class structure, method signatures, and internal data handling to support modular time-series analysis components. Ensure extensibility for future analytics features.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify class instantiation, method availability, and correct data flow through unit tests.

subtasks.title: Develop Time-Series Trend Detection and Seasonality Analysis
subtasks.description: Implement algorithms for detecting trends and seasonality in time-series data using moving averages, exponential smoothing, ARIMA, and decomposition techniques.
subtasks.details: Apply preprocessing steps such as differencing, detrending, and deseasonalizing to prepare data. Integrate STL and classical decomposition for separating trend and seasonal components. Ensure support for both linear and non-linear trends.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests with synthetic and real datasets to validate trend and seasonality extraction accuracy.

subtasks.title: Implement Pattern Recognition Algorithms
subtasks.description: Develop pattern recognition using machine learning techniques from scikit-learn to identify recurring patterns and classify time-series behaviors.
subtasks.details: Integrate clustering, classification, and feature extraction methods to detect and label patterns. Support supervised and unsupervised approaches for flexible pattern discovery.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with labeled and unlabeled datasets to ensure correct pattern identification and classification performance.

subtasks.title: Add Regression Analysis and Trend Prediction
subtasks.description: Incorporate regression models (linear, polynomial, ARIMA) to predict future trends and quantify trend strength in time-series data.
subtasks.details: Enable users to fit and evaluate multiple regression models, select optimal models based on statistical criteria, and generate trend forecasts with confidence intervals.
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate prediction accuracy using historical data with known outcomes and assess model selection robustness.

subtasks.title: Implement Anomaly Detection, Outlier Handling, and Visualization
subtasks.description: Develop statistical and machine learning-based anomaly detection, robust outlier handling, and comprehensive trend visualization and reporting features.
subtasks.details: Apply standard deviation, z-score, and model-based methods for anomaly detection. Integrate visualization tools for trend, seasonality, and anomaly reporting. Ensure exportable and interactive reporting capabilities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test detection with injected anomalies and outliers; verify visualization accuracy and usability with diverse time-series scenarios.

tasks.title: Implement Suggestion Engine
tasks.description: Create the system for generating improvement recommendations based on monitoring and analysis.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/intervention/suggestion_engine.py with SuggestionEngine class
2. Implement rule-based suggestion generation
3. Create priority and relevance scoring
4. Implement context-aware suggestion filtering
5. Add suggestion timing optimization
6. Create suggestion effectiveness tracking
7. Implement learning from suggestion outcomes

Use a combination of rule-based and machine learning approaches for suggestion generation. Implement context awareness to ensure suggestions are relevant to the current situation. Create a feedback loop for learning from suggestion outcomes.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for suggestion generation and prioritization. Create integration tests that verify suggestions are appropriate for given scenarios. Test the learning mechanism with simulated feedback. Verify that suggestions improve over time based on outcomes.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Suggestion Generation Engine
subtasks.description: Develop the SuggestionEngine class in src/intervention/suggestion_engine.py, supporting both rule-based and machine learning-driven suggestion generation.
subtasks.details: Define the architecture for the SuggestionEngine class, implement rule-based logic for generating recommendations, and integrate machine learning models for hybrid suggestion generation. Ensure the system can process monitoring and analysis data as input.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for rule-based and ML-based suggestion generation. Verify that the engine produces valid suggestions for a variety of monitored scenarios.

subtasks.title: Implement Priority and Relevance Scoring Mechanism
subtasks.description: Develop algorithms to score generated suggestions based on their priority and relevance to the current context.
subtasks.details: Design scoring functions that evaluate each suggestion's importance and contextual fit. Use features from monitoring data and user feedback to inform the scoring process.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for scoring logic. Validate that high-priority, highly relevant suggestions are ranked above less important ones in test scenarios.

subtasks.title: Develop Context-Aware Suggestion Filtering
subtasks.description: Implement filtering logic to ensure only contextually appropriate suggestions are presented to users.
subtasks.details: Leverage contextual data (e.g., user state, session history, environment) to filter out irrelevant or redundant suggestions. Ensure the filtering mechanism is extensible for new context types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create integration tests simulating different contexts. Verify that only relevant suggestions are surfaced in each scenario.

subtasks.title: Optimize Suggestion Timing and Delivery
subtasks.description: Implement mechanisms to determine the optimal timing for delivering suggestions to maximize effectiveness and minimize disruption.
subtasks.details: Analyze user interaction patterns and system events to identify ideal moments for suggestion delivery. Integrate timing logic into the SuggestionEngine workflow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate various user workflows and measure the impact of timing on suggestion acceptance and effectiveness.

subtasks.title: Establish Feedback Loop and Learning from Outcomes
subtasks.description: Create a feedback system to track suggestion effectiveness and enable the SuggestionEngine to learn from outcomes.
subtasks.details: Implement tracking of user responses and suggestion outcomes. Use this data to refine suggestion generation, scoring, and filtering, enabling continuous improvement via supervised or reinforcement learning.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with simulated feedback data to ensure the engine adapts and improves over time. Validate that learning mechanisms lead to measurable improvements in suggestion relevance and acceptance.

tasks.title: Implement Communication Module
tasks.description: Develop the system for communication between the orchestrator and ClaudeCode sessions.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/intervention/communication.py with Communication class
2. Implement non-intrusive message injection
3. Create structured message formatting
4. Implement communication channels (direct, notification, etc.)
5. Add message priority and timing management
6. Create communication feedback collection
7. Implement secure communication protocols

Use tmux's communication mechanisms for message injection. Implement proper message formatting to ensure clarity. Create multiple communication channels for different types of messages. Ensure all communication is secure and authenticated.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for message formatting and channel selection. Create integration tests that verify messages are correctly delivered to sessions. Test with various message types and priorities. Verify that communication doesn't disrupt ongoing sessions.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Communication Class
subtasks.description: Create src/intervention/communication.py and define the Communication class as the core interface for orchestrator-to-ClaudeCode session messaging.
subtasks.details: Establish the class structure, interfaces, and initialization logic. Ensure extensibility for future communication features.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests to verify class instantiation, interface methods, and basic object lifecycle.

subtasks.title: Implement Non-Intrusive Message Injection Using tmux
subtasks.description: Develop mechanisms for injecting messages into ClaudeCode sessions using tmux's communication features, ensuring minimal disruption to session workflows.
subtasks.details: Utilize tmux commands, control mode, or hooks to send messages directly to target panes or sessions without interfering with user activity. Ensure compatibility with multiple session types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create integration tests that inject messages into live sessions and verify that session state and user workflows are not disrupted.

subtasks.title: Develop Structured Message Formatting
subtasks.description: Implement a robust message formatting system to ensure clarity, consistency, and support for structured data in all communications.
subtasks.details: Define message schemas (e.g., JSON or protocol buffers), include metadata such as type, priority, and timestamp, and validate all outgoing/incoming messages against the schema.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for message serialization, deserialization, and schema validation. Test with malformed and edge-case messages.

subtasks.title: Establish Multiple Communication Channels
subtasks.description: Create and manage distinct communication channels (e.g., direct, notification, broadcast) for different message types and delivery requirements.
subtasks.details: Implement logic to route messages to appropriate channels based on type and context. Support channel registration and dynamic channel selection.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test channel selection and routing logic with various message types. Verify correct delivery and isolation between channels.

subtasks.title: Implement Secure and Prioritized Communication Management
subtasks.description: Add mechanisms for message priority handling, timing management, and secure, authenticated communication between orchestrator and sessions.
subtasks.details: Integrate priority queues, scheduling, and timing controls. Implement authentication and encryption for all communication paths to prevent unauthorized access.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test message prioritization and timing under load. Perform security tests for authentication, encryption, and resistance to unauthorized message injection.

tasks.title: Implement Pattern Recognizer
tasks.description: Create the system for detecting success and failure patterns in ClaudeCode sessions.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/learning/pattern_recognizer.py with PatternRecognizer class
2. Implement pattern definition and storage
3. Create pattern matching algorithms
4. Implement pattern scoring and ranking
5. Add pattern evolution and refinement
6. Create pattern categorization
7. Implement pattern visualization and reporting

Use machine learning techniques from scikit-learn for pattern recognition. Implement both predefined patterns and learned patterns. Use scoring mechanisms to rank pattern matches by confidence. Create a system for pattern evolution based on new observations.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for pattern matching and scoring algorithms. Create integration tests with historical data to verify pattern recognition. Test with various patterns including subtle and complex ones. Verify that pattern evolution improves recognition over time.

subtasks.title: Design Pattern Definition and Storage System
subtasks.description: Develop a system to define, represent, and store both predefined and learned patterns relevant to success and failure in ClaudeCode sessions.
subtasks.details: Specify data structures and storage mechanisms for pattern definitions. Support extensibility for new pattern types and integration with machine learning models.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests to verify correct storage, retrieval, and update of pattern definitions. Test with a variety of pattern types and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Implement Pattern Matching Algorithms
subtasks.description: Develop algorithms to match session data against stored patterns using both rule-based and machine learning approaches from scikit-learn.
subtasks.details: Integrate scikit-learn models for learned pattern recognition. Ensure support for both exact and fuzzy matching. Optimize for performance on large session datasets.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for matching logic. Use synthetic and historical session data to verify detection accuracy for both simple and complex patterns.

subtasks.title: Develop Pattern Scoring and Ranking Mechanisms
subtasks.description: Create mechanisms to score and rank pattern matches by confidence, leveraging model outputs and custom heuristics.
subtasks.details: Implement scoring functions that combine model probabilities, pattern relevance, and historical performance. Provide APIs for retrieving top-ranked matches.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test scoring consistency and ranking correctness with controlled datasets. Validate that high-confidence matches correspond to true patterns.

subtasks.title: Enable Pattern Evolution and Refinement
subtasks.description: Implement a system for evolving and refining patterns based on new session data and feedback, supporting continuous learning.
subtasks.details: Use incremental learning techniques from scikit-learn and feedback loops to update pattern definitions and model parameters over time.
subtasks.testStrategy: Simulate new data ingestion and verify that pattern recognition accuracy improves. Test rollback and versioning of evolved patterns.

subtasks.title: Build Pattern Visualization and Reporting Tools
subtasks.description: Develop visualization and reporting components to present detected patterns, their scores, and evolution history to users.
subtasks.details: Create visual dashboards and exportable reports. Include interactive elements for exploring pattern details and trends.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test visualizations with diverse pattern sets. Validate report accuracy and usability with user feedback.

tasks.title: Implement Optimization Engine
tasks.description: Develop the system for optimizing agent configurations based on monitoring and learning.
tasks.details:
1. Create src/learning/optimization_engine.py with OptimizationEngine class
2. Implement configuration parameter identification
3. Create optimization algorithms (genetic, gradient descent, etc.)
4. Implement A/B testing framework
5. Add performance impact prediction
6. Create optimization suggestion generation
7. Implement optimization effectiveness tracking

Use optimization algorithms appropriate for different types of parameters. Implement A/B testing to validate optimization suggestions. Create a feedback loop for tracking optimization effectiveness. Use machine learning for predicting performance impact.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for optimization algorithms and parameter identification. Create integration tests that verify optimizations improve performance. Test the A/B testing framework with controlled scenarios. Verify that optimization suggestions are practical and effective.

subtasks.title: Design and Implement Configuration Parameter Identification
subtasks.description: Develop mechanisms to automatically identify and categorize agent configuration parameters that are subject to optimization.
subtasks.details: Analyze agent architecture to enumerate tunable parameters, classify them by type (categorical, continuous, discrete), and implement automated discovery routines within the OptimizationEngine class.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests to verify correct identification and classification of all relevant configuration parameters in various agent setups.

subtasks.title: Develop and Integrate Optimization Algorithms
subtasks.description: Implement multiple optimization algorithms (e.g., genetic algorithms, gradient descent, Bayesian optimization) suitable for different parameter types and integrate them into the OptimizationEngine.
subtasks.details: Select and implement algorithms based on parameter characteristics; ensure modularity so algorithms can be selected or combined dynamically. Provide interfaces for algorithm configuration and result retrieval.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for each optimization algorithm and integration tests to ensure algorithms improve agent configurations as expected.

subtasks.title: Implement A/B Testing and Validation Framework
subtasks.description: Build an A/B testing framework to validate the effectiveness of optimization suggestions by comparing performance between baseline and optimized configurations.
subtasks.details: Enable automated experiment setup, random assignment, and statistical analysis of results. Integrate with monitoring to collect relevant metrics and ensure statistical significance of outcomes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Develop integration tests using controlled scenarios to verify correct experiment setup, assignment, and result analysis. Validate that the framework detects meaningful performance differences.

subtasks.title: Integrate Performance Impact Prediction Using Machine Learning
subtasks.description: Develop machine learning models to predict the performance impact of proposed configuration changes before deployment.
subtasks.details: Collect historical configuration and performance data, select appropriate regression or classification models, and integrate prediction into the optimization suggestion workflow.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit and integration tests to assess prediction accuracy using historical data and simulated configuration changes.

subtasks.title: Implement Optimization Suggestion Generation and Effectiveness Tracking
subtasks.description: Generate actionable optimization suggestions based on algorithm outputs and track their effectiveness over time to enable continuous improvement.
subtasks.details: Develop logic to translate optimization results into clear suggestions, record their application, and monitor resulting performance changes. Establish feedback loops for iterative refinement.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test that suggestions are generated, applied, and tracked correctly. Verify that effectiveness metrics reflect actual performance improvements and support iterative optimization.

tasks.title: Create Utility Scripts
tasks.description: Develop utility and deployment scripts for environment setup and orchestrator management.
tasks.details:
1. Create scripts/setup.sh for environment setup automation
2. Implement scripts/start-orchestrator.sh for session orchestrator launching
3. Create emergency fix scripts in scripts/emergency-fixes/
4. Implement deployment scripts in scripts/deployment/
5. Add utility scripts for common operations
6. Create backup and recovery scripts
7. Implement monitoring and maintenance scripts

Use bash for scripts with proper error handling and logging. Implement argument parsing for flexible script usage. Create comprehensive help documentation for each script. Ensure scripts are cross-platform compatible where possible.
tasks.testStrategy: Create tests for script functionality using bats (Bash Automated Testing System) or similar. Test scripts on different platforms to ensure compatibility. Verify that scripts handle error conditions gracefully. Test with various input parameters to ensure flexibility.

subtasks.title: Automate Environment Setup Script
subtasks.description: Develop scripts/setup.sh to automate environment setup, including dependency installation and configuration.
subtasks.details: Script must use Bash with robust error handling (set -euo pipefail), argument parsing for flexible usage, and logging of all actions. Include comprehensive help documentation and ensure cross-platform compatibility where feasible.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test on supported platforms for successful environment setup, verify error handling by simulating failures, and check help output for completeness.

subtasks.title: Implement Orchestrator Launch Script
subtasks.description: Create scripts/start-orchestrator.sh to launch and manage the session orchestrator.
subtasks.details: Script should accept arguments for session parameters, implement error handling and logging, and provide detailed help documentation. Ensure the script can be invoked reliably across platforms.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test launching orchestrator with various parameters, simulate orchestrator failures to verify error handling, and validate help output.

subtasks.title: Develop Emergency Fix Scripts
subtasks.description: Create scripts in scripts/emergency-fixes/ to address common emergency scenarios and system recovery tasks.
subtasks.details: Each script must include error handling, logging, argument parsing, and clear help documentation. Scripts should be modular and easily extensible for new emergency cases.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each emergency script in simulated failure scenarios, verify logging and error messages, and ensure help documentation is accurate.

subtasks.title: Create Deployment Automation Scripts
subtasks.description: Implement deployment scripts in scripts/deployment/ to automate application deployment and updates.
subtasks.details: Scripts must handle deployment steps, rollbacks, and status checks with robust error handling and logging. Include argument parsing for deployment options and comprehensive help documentation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test deployment and rollback processes, simulate deployment errors, and verify script output and help documentation.

subtasks.title: Add Utility, Backup, and Monitoring Scripts
subtasks.description: Develop utility scripts for common operations, backup/recovery, and monitoring/maintenance in the scripts/ directory.
subtasks.details: Scripts must include error handling, logging, argument parsing, and help documentation. Ensure scripts are modular and cross-platform compatible where possible.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test each utility, backup, and monitoring script for correct operation, error handling, and help output across supported platforms.
